NE.name: Impôt sur le revenu des valeurs mobilières, dividends (10 %, final)
NE.statute: CGI 2013 updated to LF 2022, art. 69, 74 (Ordonnance 2024-59, LF 2025, checked: art. 69-111 not amended; LF 2023 and LF 2024 not held)
NE.doc: art. 74: 10 % on dividends (7 % from companies listed on a CREPMF-approved exchange), 7 % on gains on shares, 6 % on bonds, 5 % on gains on bonds, 15 % on other products; the levies are final.

NE.name: Impôt sur le revenu des créances, interest on deposit and current accounts (10 %)
NE.statute: CGI 2013/LF 2022 art. 79-80 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2023-2024 not held)
NE.doc: art. 80: 20 %, but 10 % for interest on deposit and current accounts with banks and similar bodies, exchange agents, brokers, treasurers and agricultural credit funds (the household's interest is taken to be bank interest).

NE.name: IRVM on gains on shares (7 %, final)
Impôt sur les plus-values de cessions immobilières (5 %)
NE.doc: art. 110: gain = sale price less the acquisition price, the latter increased by a flat 10 % for acquisition costs and by works; art. 111: 5 %.
unsupported: flat 10 % uplift of the acquisition price for acquisition costs (art. 110): the household's stated costs are used instead
works at cost or a flat 10 %

NE.name: Taxe d'apprentissage (3 %)
NE.statute: CGI Livre I art. 129-130 as replaced by Ordonnance n° 2024-59 (LF 2025) art. 15, from 1 January 2025
NE.doc: art. 129 (new): base = all remuneration paid in money plus benefits in kind, less listed deductions (new firms' first year, training costs, apprentices, new permanent contracts...); art. 130 (new): 3 % (the former 5 % for non-national workers and the reductions of art. 131-136 are repealed).
unsupported: deductions of art. 129 (new firms, apprentices, net pay of new contracts in the year)

NE.name: Impôt sur les revenus des baux d'habitation (12 % of annual rental value; main residence exempt)
NE.statute: CGI Livre I art. 146-148, 159 as amended by Ordonnance n° 2024-59 (LF 2025) art. 16
NE.doc: art. 147: base = rental value of buildings let as dwellings; art. 148 (new): 12 % of the annual rental value, 6 % for free and secondary dwellings; art. 159 6° (new): the main residence is exempt. The household's other buildings are taken as let dwellings.
unsupported: 6 % for dwellings occupied free and secondary homes
impôt sur les revenus des baux professionnels 12 % (art. 151)
